concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-braintree-auth-node]] - Closed-beta Node.js Braintree Auth notifications for connected-merchant underwriting/application and PayPal link-status events, with connected-merchant and OAuth-application payload routes
warnings: Preserve the unqualified closed-beta notice; this page does not state a separate sandbox-versus-production availability rule.
Retain both alternatives for `connected_merchant_status_transitioned`: underwriting status changed or an application was submitted.
Retain successful PayPal account linking or unlinking as the condition for `connected_merchant_paypal_status_changed`.
Do not import OAuth access-revocation or Grant API payment-instrument semantics merely because an OAuth application client ID appears in the payload categories.
Treat the separate Braintree Auth guide as navigation-only until it is fully read.
